text: Based on the tool output, tree-cover loss on this property has been detected in recent years, but it is not increasing. While there was a notable loss event in 2021 (81.3 ha), subsequent years showed much smaller loss areas (0.6 ha in 2022 and 4.5 ha in 2023). Additionally, losses in patches under 0.5 ha also decreased from 37.3 ha in 2021 to 0.3 ha in 2022 and 1.3 ha in 2023. Therefore, the trend suggests a decrease in tree-cover loss on this property in recent years.
